title: Chapter 224 The Cocktail Party In The Tent
content:
Chapter 224 The Cocktail Party In The Tent

It's a pity that Yu Guo didn't send anyone to fight in this battle, otherwise, we must show them the bravery of my Yu Guo man.

Shaking his head, Zhong Yu could only sigh helplessly, turned to look at the battlefield, and continued to observe the situation.

The situation on the battlefield was just as he had expected. The army formed by the Allied Forces of the Three Kingdoms was very complicated, and each of them had some fear of Qin.

What's more, with Li Xin and Meng Tian, the new generation of brave generals, they led cavalry, constantly seeking breakthroughs in transitions, constantly destroying the original formation of the coalition forces, and causing even greater collapse.

Under such a situation, the 200,000 coalition forces had already killed more than 50,000 people in just one morning, and the rest were panicked, with people constantly collapsing and fleeing.

Looking around, on the battlefield, the soldiers of the coalition army all fled quickly after fighting the Qin army for a while, and did not dare to beat them again.

However, Qin Jun was not without outstanding performance. Among them, the big iron hammer from Yan State, who had seen several times, performed very well.

Big Iron Hammer's current official position is the general of a 3,000-strong army of the Yan State. His position is located on the outskirts of the right flank of the army, which is the first line of resistance against the Qin State.

Usually, this position is the one with the heaviest casualties. Before the start of the battle, they will all be wiped out in less than an hour, and they will be crippled and retreated to the rear to recuperate.

However, under the leadership of the big hammer, this law has changed.

Under his leadership, the 3,000 Yan soldiers under his leadership changed from lambs to wolves, and rushed towards the Qin army.

And with such momentum, he broke through several thousand-man phalanxes of Qin State all the way, and finally defeated a ten-thousand-man phalanx of Qin State in one fell swoop. His performance can be said to be extremely eye-catching, even amazing.

At least, looking around the battlefield, Zhong Yu didn't see anything comparable to the big hammer.

"King Yan, the one below is the big iron hammer of your Yan Kingdom, right? I met him a few times in Jicheng before, and I knew at that time that he is a brave and skilled fighter. With such bravery, he was able to break the Qin army's phalanx several times, which really opened my eyes, Yanzhao is worthy of being a generous and tragic man!" With a long sigh, Zhong Yu knew the direction of the big hammer, and moved towards Yan Wangxi beside him, Exclaimed.

"Your Majesty King Jing has said it before, the big hammer is no more than a man, how can it compare to the bravery of the soldiers of the Yu Kingdom!" King Yan was happy when he heard Zhong Yu's praise, and said modestly.

He doesn't know what a big hammer is, he only knows that the image of Yan Guo's weak and weak soldiers in the past has been changed by this person who he doesn't know, and he has saved face.

In King Yan's heart, he made up his mind that after the big hammer came back, he must ask him for news, and then reward him heavily and promote him to an official position.

After all, Big Iron Hammer gave Yan Guo a face this time. Thinking of King Han's envious and jealous face just now, King Yan felt relieved for a while.

However, on the battlefield, although there are brave men like Big Hammer, they cannot change the general trend of the coalition forces retreating steadily on the battlefield.

Time passed quickly, the sky was dark in the blink of an eye, and it was about to enter the night, and the armies of both sides also slowly retreated from the battlefield under their respective Mingjin.

Many people just returned to the barracks, lying on the ground, weeping with tears on their faces, they were crying for their dead friends and relatives, and they were thankful that they had lived another day.

Life is full of vicissitudes, it is difficult to speak, and nothing can make people feel more heartbroken than the battlefield.

However, in the barracks, the Chinese military tent in the center is another scene.

During the battle, hundreds of banquets were fully set up at this moment, and there were still some elder sisters dancing, and there were even musicians playing songs on both sides, creating a scene of singing and dancing.

For this banquet, all the generals with more than a thousand people in the army were all in place, except for certain positions where they had to fulfill their duties, almost all of them came.

And this banquet has several protagonists, among which the kings of the three countries are naturally the most eye-catching among them. Besides, it is the big hammer who has the most outstanding performance on the battlefield.

"Big Iron Hammer, on the battlefield today, the 3,000 soldiers you led performed the most outstandingly. They defeated Qin State repeatedly, and even Qin State's 10,000-strong army was defeated by you. You are really an enemy of 10,000 people!" Raising his wine glass, Zhong Yu praised the big hammer.

"Your Highness is too well-respected. These are just fulfilling your duties. As a man of the Yan Kingdom, you are not afraid of these two words!" Big Hammer also boldly raised the wine glass in his hand, drank it down, and said with a smile.

"It can't be said that meritorious service is meritorious service. If you have meritorious service, how can you not leave? Tell me, what reward do you want!" Shaking his head, Zhong Yu really let it go, and clear rewards and punishments are the best way to keep an army alive .

"I really don't need any rewards, but if His Highness really wants to give them, why not give me some wine and meat, and let me take them back to drink with my brothers. After all, I don't know if I will be alive in the future!" The big hammer shook Shaking his head, he pleaded for his brothers.

"That's it, no matter what, those soldiers under your command have made such contributions to our coalition army, and it's not justified not to reward them. You can bring back a hundred sheep and two hundred altars of wine later, and have a good drink with your brothers after you go back. After pondering for a while, Zhong Yu nodded, agreeing to Big Iron Hammer's request.

"Thank you, Your Highness, those brothers under the minister's command, thank you for your kindness!" Big Iron Hammer's face brightened, and he quickly thanked him.

Seeing the grateful face of the big iron hammer, although Zhong Yu also had some joy on his face, he thought for a while in his heart. I feel that this kind of reward is still not enough, I have to do something, use the reward for the big hammer to motivate these generals in the tent, let them work harder in the next battle.

After thinking for a while, Zhong Yu turned his head, and said to King Yan who was sitting next to him, who was receiving awards for his generals, with a face full of pride:

"His Royal Highness, the bravery of the big hammer under your command, and the bravery of the soldiers of the country of Yan make the king feel very admired, but the reward of some wine and meat may not be enough. The lonely king proposes that it is better to raise the big hammer from a thousand generals. What will happen to thousands of people?"

"This, this, isn't it a bit too honorable!" Hearing this question suddenly and this unexpected proposal, King Yan was a little startled and didn't know what to do.

After all, he is a general of ten thousand people. Of the 100,000 people brought by Yan State, more than 40,000 people have been killed in today's battle, and only 60,000 people are left. One-sixth of the people will be used to promote this man. The big iron hammer still made King Yan hesitate.
